Fleet Maintenance and Damage Documentation Bundle
Galaxy Forge Implementation Kit v1.0 (September 2026)

FILES
- fleet_maintenance_damage_bundle_guide.pdf : main implementation guide
- fleet_maintenance_damage_bundle_workbook.xlsx : Excel workbook (4 sheets)
- pre_post_rental_inspection_form.docx : editable template

- service_visit_record.docx : editable template

HOW TO USE: start with Quick Start (section 2 of the guide), then work the 14-day plan in section 9.
SUPPORT: email support for file/usage questions within 7 days of purchase.
